key_findings: HDAC5 RNA and protein are upregulated in trigeminal ganglia in chronic orofacial neuropathic pain models and normalized by Class IIa inhibitor LMK235.
LMK235 reverses mechanical/cold hypersensitivity, reduces TG neuron excitability and sag ratio, and prevents anxiety/depression-like behavior.
